entities.summary: Corey Damon Davis is an American former professional football player who was a wide receiver in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Western Michigan Broncos, where he became the NCAA Division I FBS leader in career receiving yards. Davis was selected by the Tennessee Titans fifth overall in the 2017 NFL draft, where he played for four seasons before signing with the New York Jets.
